title: Digest podcast status lookup materializes every episode

evidence.quote:
all_episodes = session.exec(
            select(PodcastEpisode).order_by(PodcastEpisode.created_at.desc())
        ).all()
        episode = next(
            (ep for ep in all_episodes if digest_id_str in (ep.digest_ids or [])),

reasoning: The GET /digests/{digest_id}/podcast handler performs an unbounded select of all podcast_episodes, materializes them in Python, and then scans each episode's JSON digest_ids for the requested digest. This makes a network-exposed status check O(total podcast episodes) in time and memory. As scheduled/manual podcast history grows, ordinary status polling can become slow and can hold database connections longer than needed.
reproduction: Create many podcast_episodes rows whose digest_ids do not contain the requested digest, then call GET /api/digests/{digest_id}/podcast. The handler loads every row before finding the matching episode or returning 404.
recommendation: Move the digest-id membership predicate into the database and return only the newest matching row. For SQLite JSON, use an EXISTS subquery over json_each(podcast_episodes.digest_ids) ordered by created_at desc with LIMIT 1, or introduce a normalized episode-to-digest association table with an index on digest_id.
whyTestsDoNotAlreadyCoverThis: The discovered success test only creates a single matching episode before calling the route, so it verifies the happy path but cannot detect the unbounded scan or row materialization behavior.
suggestedRegressionTest: Seed many non-matching podcast episodes plus one matching episode and assert the route's lookup uses a database-filtered, limited query rather than loading unrelated episodes into Python; alternatively cover a dedicated lookup helper and inspect the compiled SQLite statement/query plan for a JSON membership predicate and LIMIT 1.
minimumFixScope: Change get_digest_podcast_status to query for the requested digest_id directly and fetch at most one PodcastEpisode; keep the response schema unchanged.
